svg.text: Roll 4,440 mm of 25 x 4 mm flat bar the easy way into a ring

svg.text: 1,400 mm inside diameter (by hand round a ring of stakes, or

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: by a local fabricator with rolls). Join the ends with a 100 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: strap of the same bar inside, four M5 bolts, at a rib position.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark twelve rib positions 30 degrees apart, starting 15 degrees

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the two stand-off positions, which are opposite each other.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill: 9 mm pairs (30 mm apart) at the two stand-off positions;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 6.5 mm pair (24 mm apart) at the gnomon, midway between two

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ribs; 5.5 mm for each rim clip; tab rivets at assembly.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: round within 3 mm across any two diameters.
